parties.respondent: Bihar Legislative Council (Through Secretary) and Ors.

summary: Expulsion of MLC challenged on grounds of violation of natural justice; non-supply of evidence, unilateral advancement of hearing date without notice, selective circulation of report to ruling party members, disproportionate penalty compared to co-accused; principles of fair procedure and graded discipline emphasized; challenge to confidentiality-based denial of material.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 32 of the Constitution of India
